question: Rickets and night-blindness are caused by the deficiency of ______ and ______, respectively.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vitamin D, Vitamin A.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Night Blindness and Xerophthalmia** are caused due to the deficiency of Vitamin A.
 
• **Rickets **is caused due to deficiency of Vitamin D.
